editor.premise: A holiday decorating day, from gathering forest greenery to making wreaths and building a festive entrance, guided by playful written narration.

chapters.name: Forest gathering
chapters.purpose: Rewind from finished decorations to collecting their raw materials.

chapters.name: Door wreath
chapters.purpose: Return home, assemble the wreath, then reveal it in place.

chapters.name: Outdoor display
chapters.purpose: Build larger decorations, retain a mishap, and complete the entrance.

chapters.name: More holiday details
chapters.purpose: Introduce another decorating section; alternate seasonal inserts with animal interludes.

captions.note: Small bottom-centered narration spans several cuts; occasional centered yellow headings mark sections. Longer sentences explain actions and folklore, with brief comic asides.

editor.notes: Keep the preview under a second per image, then slow for readable handwork. Skip repetitive fastening with jump cuts. Separate work stages with landscape breaths, and show finished objects both in context and close.
